title: Only a finite number of qubits can be entangled

statements.text: Because the bit strings behind complex Hilbert states have finite length, only a finite number of qubits can be entangled and still show quantum entanglement statistics. This inherent limit to coherence may relate to Penrose's gravitational decoherence.

sources.quote: This implies that only a finite number of qubits can be entangled and still show quantum entanglement statistics.
In this finite representation there is an upper limit to the number of qubits that can be entangled
